concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-pay-out-to-cards-funds-disbursement]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service Transfers API guide for third-party Mastercard/Visa card payouts using PCI-gated raw data or CardOnFile/Subscription tokens, with future-date one-attempt and webhook-booking boundaries.
warnings: Raw-card table marks cardHolder.reference required and tied to shopperReference (raw lines 58–66), while adjacent curl omits it (67–107).
Future-date prose uses Balance Platform timezone by default but field table says Europe/Amsterdam (raw lines 641, 656 and repeated sections); unresolved default.
HTTP 2XX examples end authorised, not booked or recipient credited (raw lines 583–633, 1246–1295, 1907–1956).
